name: Bank of England
note: The UK's central bank: sets Bank Rate, issues banknotes and supervises banks (Prudential Regulation Authority).

name: London Stock Exchange
note: The UK's main stock exchange, at Paternoster Square. Home of the FTSE 100 and FTSE 250 companies' primary listings.

name: Lloyd's of London
note: The insurance and reinsurance market in the Lloyd's building, Lime Street.

name: Financial Conduct Authority
note: The conduct regulator for financial firms and markets, at Endeavour Square, Stratford.

name: Exchange district (Edinburgh)
note: Edinburgh's financial district around Lothian Road and Festival Square: banks, insurers and fund managers.
